description: Map ClinVar DMD copy-number deletions onto Ensembl exon structure to recover reading frame and compute exon-skipping amenability
code:
import requests, json, re, os, time
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- 1. DMD canonical transcript exon structure from Ensembl REST ----------
TX="ENST00000357033"
r=requests.get(f"https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/id/{TX}?expand=1;content-type=application/json", timeout=120)
tx=r.json()
print("transcript", tx["id"], tx["display_name"], "strand", tx["strand"], "exons", len(tx["Exon"]))
tr=tx["Translation"]; cds_min, cds_max = tr["start"], tr["end"]
exons=sorted(tx["Exon"], key=lambda e: e["start"], reverse=(tx["strand"]==-1))
# rank order along transcript: strand -1 means highest genomic coord = exon 1
ex=[]
for i,e in enumerate(exons, start=1):
    s,en=e["start"],e["end"]
    cs,ce=max(s,cds_min), min(en,cds_max)       # coding portion
    coding = max(0, ce-cs+1)
    ex.append(dict(rank=i, g_start=s, g_end=en, length=en-s+1, coding=coding))
EX=pd.DataFrame(ex)
print("total coding bases:", EX.coding.sum(), "( /3 =", EX.coding.sum()/3, ")  n_coding_exons:", (EX.coding>0).sum())
print(EX.head(3).to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 2. Load ClinVar snapshot saved in iteration 1 ----------
recs=json.load(open("clinvar_dmd_plp_esummary_raw.json"))
print("clinvar records loaded:", len(recs))
B="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
PLP='("clinsig pathogenic"[Properties] OR "clinsig likely pathogenic"[Properties])'
sets={}
for k,q in {"DMD":f'DMD[gene] AND "Duchenne muscular dystrophy"[dis] AND {PLP}',
            "BMD":f'DMD[gene] AND "Becker muscular dystrophy"[dis] AND {PLP}'}.items():
    sets[k]=set(requests.get(B+"esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":q,"retmax":10000,"retmode":"json"},timeout=120).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"])
    time.sleep(0.35)

def loc38(r):
    for vs in (r.get("variation_set") or []):
        for L in (vs.get("variation_loc") or []):
            if L.get("assembly_name")=="GRCh38" and L.get("start") and L.get("stop"):
                try: return int(L["start"]), int(L["stop"])
                except: pass
    return None

def deleted_exons(s,e):
    """exons fully contained in the deleted genomic interval"""
    m=EX[(EX.g_start>=s)&(EX.g_end<=e)]
    return list(m["rank"]), int(m.coding.sum())

rows=[]
for r in recs:
    obj=r.get("obj_type","")
    if obj not in ("Deletion","Duplication","copy number loss","copy number gain"): continue
    L=loc38(r)
    if not L: continue
    s,e=L
    if e-s+1 < 200: continue                 # restrict to multi-exon/large events
    ranks, coding = deleted_exons(s,e)
    if not ranks: continue
    uid=r.get("uid")
    ph=[k for k in ("DMD","BMD") if uid in sets[k]]
    rows.append(dict(uid=uid, accession=r.get("accession"), obj_type=obj,
                     g_start=s, g_end=e, exons=",".join(map(str,ranks)),
                     first_exon=min(ranks), last_exon=max(ranks), n_exons=len(ranks),
                     coding_bases=coding, frame_mod3=coding%3,
                     pheno=";".join(ph) or "none", title=r.get("title")))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\nCNV events mapped to exons:", len(D), " (deletions:", (D.obj_type.isin(['Deletion','copy number loss'])).sum(), ")")
D.to_csv("clinvar_dmd_cnv_exonmapped.csv", index=False)

dele=D[D.obj_type.isin(["Deletion","copy number loss"])].copy()
dele["frame"]=np.where(dele.frame_mod3==0,"in-frame","out-of-frame")
print("\nFrame distribution of exon-level deletions:\n", dele.frame.value_counts().to_string())

ex_lab=dele[dele.pheno.isin(["DMD","BMD"])]
ct=pd.crosstab(ex_lab.frame, ex_lab.pheno).reindex(index=["out-of-frame","in-frame"],columns=["DMD","BMD"]).fillna(0)
print("\nExon-level deletions, exclusive ClinVar label:\n", ct)
if ct.shape==(2,2) and ct.values.min()>=0:
    orr,p=stats.fisher_exact(ct.values)
    a,b_,c_,d_=ct.values.ravel().astype(float)
    se=np.sqrt(sum(1/max(x,0.5) for x in (a,b_,c_,d_)))
    print(f"OR(out-of-frame -> Duchenne) = {orr:.2f} [95% CI {np.exp(np.log(max(orr,1e-9))-1.96*se):.2f}-{np.exp(np.log(max(orr,1e-9))+1.96*se):.2f}], p={p:.3g}, N={int(ct.values.sum())}")

# ---------- 3. Exon-skipping amenability of out-of-frame deletions ----------
coding_len=dict(zip(EX["rank"],EX.coding))
def amenable(first,last,target):
    """single-exon skip of `target` adjacent to the deletion restores frame?"""
    if target==first-1 or target==last+1:
        tot=sum(coding_len.get(x,0) for x in range(min(first,target), max(last,target)+1))
        return tot%3==0
    return False
oof=dele[dele.frame=="out-of-frame"].copy()
amen={}
for t in [8,43,44,45,50,51,52,53,55]:
    amen[t]=int(oof.apply(lambda r: amenable(r.first_exon, r.last_exon, t), axis=1).sum())
tot_oof=len(oof)
am=pd.Series(amen)/tot_oof*100
print(f"\nExon-skipping amenability among {tot_oof} out-of-frame exon-level deletions in ClinVar:")
for t in am.sort_values(ascending=False).index:
    print(f"  skip exon {t:>2}: {amen[t]:>3} deletions ({am[t]:.1f}%)")
print("Published reference fractions (all DMD patients): exon 51 ~13%, exon 53 ~8-10%, exon 45 ~8%")

# ---------- 4. Figures ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(16,4.6))
h=dele.groupby("first_exon").size()
axes[0].bar(h.index, h.values, color="#4C72B0", width=1.0)
axes[0].set_xlabel("first deleted exon"); axes[0].set_ylabel("deletions (n)")
axes[0].set_title(f"Deletion start positions, n={len(dele)}\nClinVar P/LP, GRCh38, exon-mapped")
axes[0].axvspan(44,55,color="orange",alpha=.25); axes[0].axvspan(2,20,color="green",alpha=.18)
axes[0].text(49,h.max()*0.9,"distal\nhotspot",ha="center",fontsize=8)
axes[0].text(11,h.max()*0.9,"proximal\nhotspot",ha="center",fontsize=8)
fr=dele.frame.value_counts()
axes[1].pie(fr.values, labels=[f"{i}\n{v} ({100*v/len(dele):.0f}%)" for i,v in fr.items()],
            colors=["#C44E52","#55A868"], startangle=90)
axes[1].set_title("Frame effect of exon-level deletions\nin the ClinVar pathogenic set")
ams=am.sort_values(ascending=True)
axes[2].barh([f"exon {i}" for i in ams.index], ams.values, color="#8172B2")
axes[2].set_xlabel("% of out-of-frame ClinVar deletions made in-frame")
axes[2].set_title("Single-exon skip amenability\n(computed from DMD exon coding lengths)")
for i,v in enumerate(ams.values): axes[2].text(v+0.2,i,f"{v:.1f}%",va="center",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
